claims.evidence: Witness did not observe the device powered on or tested.
The witness report describes a used electronic keyboard.
Functional status of keys and buttons was not shown or tested.

risks.risk: Internal electronic failure or dead keys
risks.proof: A video clip of every key being pressed and sounding clearly.

risks.risk: The 'thin dark vertical line' is a crack in the keys
risks.proof: A high-resolution close-up photo of the affected keys on the left side.
risks.if_unproven: as having physical damage to the keybed

risks.proof: A photo of the adapter and a photo of the keyboard powered on using it.

risks.risk: Corroded battery compartment or damaged rear ports
risks.proof: Clear photos of the battery compartment and the rear connection panel.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard being played to confirm all keys and speakers work.
Photo of the keyboard powered on showing the LCD screen active.
Close-up photo of the dark vertical line on the left keys.
Photo of the included power adapter.
Photos of the rear ports and the battery compartment.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified by the witness, allowing for a baseline price. However, the price must reflect the worst-case scenario regarding the visible line on the keys and the unverified functional status.
